summary: Voters in Sadabad mostly raise contaminated tubewell water, power cuts from substation faults, a market road that was broken for years and is only half rebuilt, and waterlogged drains, while the main appreciation is a new waiting room and drinking-water kiosk and a partly built road widening.

positives.english: A drinking water kiosk and a waiting room have been built near the bus stand
positives.hindi: बस स्टैंड के पास प्याऊ और प्रतीक्षालय बन गया है, गर्मी और बारिश में राहत
positives.basis: Amar Ujala video report (published 14 Jul 2026; the event was on the Monday before, i.e. 13 Jul) says a pyau (free drinking water point) and a passenger waiting room near the Sadabad bus stand were inaugurated by the local MP and MLA, on the initiative of the Nagar Panchayat chairperson. The report says the facilities give relief from summer heat and monsoon rain. Completed facility, so a delivered benefit. Town-level, inside the Nagar Panchayat.

positives.english: The Sadabad to Raya road is being widened, and most of the town stretch is already done
positives.hindi: सादाबाद-राया सड़क चौड़ी हो रही है, शहर वाला ज्यादातर हिस्सा बन चुका है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (31 May 2026): PWD (Lok Nirman Vibhag) urban stretch of 2.025 km being widened from 7 m to 10 m, about Rs 3 crore, with about 1,100 m of cement-concrete road; 925 of the 1,100 m is already complete. No completion date given. The headline calls it the Sadabad-Raya road, while the body calls the route Sadabad-Mathura (29.6 km, of which PWD Hathras handles 12.6 km). Positive is limited to the urban stretch.

positives.english: Two of the new water tanks under Amrit 2.0 are about 80 percent built
positives.hindi: पानी की दो नई टंकियां लगभग 80 प्रतिशत बन चुकी हैं
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (31 Mar 2026), sidebar of the Amrit 2.0 report: 4 new overhead tanks planned, 2 are 80 percent complete; target completion stated as June 2026. The same article says the Rs 43.19 crore plan is practically impossible to deliver on the ground because of water quality, so this is a weak positive, not a working water supply.

positives.english: Complaints are heard at grievance days, and some are settled on the spot
positives.hindi: समाधान दिवस में शिकायतें सुनी जाती हैं, कुछ का मौके पर ही हल हुआ
positives.basis: Dainik Bhaskar (published 16 May 2026): a Sampoorna Samadhan Diwas joint hearing was held in Sadabad tehsil with the MLA, the DM and the SP. 235 complaints were received across the district, and 15 were resolved on the spot. District-level event held in Sadabad tehsil; the article does not say the complaints were only from this AC.

positives.english: A power fault at the Marghat Road substation was repaired and supply came back the same day
positives.hindi: उपकेंद्र की खराबी उसी दिन ठीक हो गई, बिजली वापस आ गई
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (16 Sep 2026): a cable box fault in the cold feeder BCB at the 33/11 kV Marghat Road substation in Sadabad cut supply for about 2,000 consumers from about 8 AM to 1:30 PM; XEN Amit Kumar said it was repaired and supply restored. Single incident and an official account; weakest positive.

negatives.english: The water here is salty and heavy, and we cannot drink it without a filter
negatives.hindi: यहां का पानी खारा और भारी है, बिना फिल्टर के पीना मुश्किल है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (31 Mar 2026), Sadabad Nagar Panchayat: test borings for proposed tubewells show TDS of 1,800 to 2,000 (the article's drinking-water standard is below 500). Jal Nigam Executive Engineer says no suitable boring site has been found yet. Residents without RO filters say they have no option but to drink it; advocate Surendra Parashar says the water tastes bad, and resident Ashok Verma says it is too heavy and salty without filtering. The article gives 18 proposed tubewells in the text and 20 in the sidebar; the TDS figure is quoted as stated.

negatives.english: When power goes, we have to fetch water from handpumps
negatives.hindi: बिजली जाने पर हैंडपंप से पानी भरना पड़ता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (16 Sep 2026): about 2,000 consumers in Sadabad were without power for about five hours after a fault at the 33/11 kV Marghat Road substation (Town One and Cold feeders). Residents had to fetch water from handpumps, and flour mills stopped during the hot spell. The article does not record a public complaint.

negatives.english: The market road was broken for four years before it was rebuilt, and only half is done
negatives.hindi: बाजार की सड़क चार साल खराब रही, अभी आधी ही बनी है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (7 Jun 2026), headline 'Road in Sadabad's main market constructed after four years': about 1,100 m from Ganesh Dwar to Agra Chungi, about Rs 99 lakh, by the Nagar Panchayat. Half was built overnight; the rest is to follow in a later phase. Locals and traders said they had been travelling on a dilapidated road, though no direct quotes are given.

negatives.english: Water stands on the roads and lanes when it rains, and the drains are poor
negatives.hindi: बारिश में सड़क और गलियों में पानी भर जाता है, नालियां खराब हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (21 Jun 2026): Rs 98.01 lakh of drain and sewer works sanctioned for the Nagar Panchayat from the 15th Finance Commission tied grant, including replacing old drains in Ward 08 and on Mathura Road, with the ADM saying the aim is to reduce waterlogging (works approved, not reported as completed). Amar Ujala (29 Sep 2026): the DM ordered a sanitation drive from 1 October focused on draining waterlogged areas. Waterlogging is acknowledged by officials; the voter line is a paraphrase.

negatives.english: The Sadabad to Mathura road is still broken, and work on that side is only starting
negatives.hindi: सादाबाद-मथुरा सड़क अभी जर्जर है, उस तरफ काम अभी शुरू हो रहा है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (31 May 2026): the 29.6 km Sadabad road is described as dilapidated, with travellers bouncing over it. The Mathura-side stretch (about 10.4 km) renovation is approved at about Rs 4.77 crore; the tender is finished and construction is being started. No completion date. AC membership unconfirmed for the stretch outside Sadabad town, since the Wikipedia extent page names no tehsils or villages.

notes: Identity confirmed from the Wikipedia 'List of constituencies of the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly' row: 79 Sadabad, district Hathras, reserved status None, Lok Sabha Hathras. The Sadabad Assembly constituency Wikipedia page names no tehsils, villages or extent, so AC membership rests on the namesake rule (Sadabad Nagar Panchayat town) and on the news reports naming Sadabad town. Sadabad-area villages such as Palhawat (Bhaskar, 28 May 2026, 3 days without power) and the 50-village saline water issue (Patrika 22 Mar 2018, which says 50 villages across Sadabad and Sikandrarao ACs) were not used because AC membership is unconfirmed or the source is too old. Sadabad-Raya and Sadabad-Mathura road naming conflicts between the Amar Ujala headline and body. The Hathras district page and an older MLA listing name Ramveer Upadhyay, while the Wikipedia AC page names Pradeep Kumar Singh (RLD) and Amar Ujala names Pradeep Chaudhary; no politician names are used in the statements. Sugarcane dues, stray cattle and highway accidents were searched but no Sadabad-specific 2024-2026 reporting was found (an Amar Ujala Dec 2023 road-accident video gives no date and does not name the highway, so it was not used). Election framing (2027 polls, caste arithmetic) was skipped per the brief. The Mar 2026 Amar Ujala report is internally inconsistent on tubewell count (18 vs 20) and the Amrit 2.0 completion date is stated as June 2026 with no later update found. Field checks recommended: current status of the Marghat Road substation cable, the drain works, and whether the Sadabad-Mathura road's Mathura-side stretch has started.
